# Spanish 05 — C1 precise communication

Conceptual deck `deck:es-MX:05`. This implements [issue #19](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/19), [Spanish plan #2](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/2#stage-05) and [roadmap #1](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/1), under the unchanged [pinned Spanish guide](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/blob/e1d8239b7560f26b092cc7bb97c005738b34361f/languages/es.md#66-advanced-development). The stage has exactly 1,400 original text cards, `es-05-0001`–`es-05-1400`, and one synchronized mapping per card. All 35 author/editor pairs and the one exhaustive final editorial pass are complete; editorial acceptance here is distinct from ORCHESTRATOR project acceptance.

Verified starting main is `9ccd5e6818adeefe8da264b78463dcd483a29cc4`, tree `07d7b8d1e04e32f76d70a70525eca620d0d3b63b`. The eight accepted Spanish 01–04 source/coverage files, all nine guides, `.gitignore` and `AGENTS.md` are protected: 19 files. Accepted project progress remains 4/7 Spanish stages and 3,600/7,600 cards until ORCHESTRATOR acceptance; accepting 05 would bring 5,000. Spanish 06/07 are unassigned.

## Separate reconciliation of the twelve §6.6 requirements

| Actual guide requirement | Mapped ID ranges and teachable evidence | Text adaptation limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Synthesis of several sources | 0241–0420; 0791–0960: original attributed short statements, source relationships, agreement, divergence and faithful reformulation. | Short source components do not establish performance on long authentic sources. |
| Implied meaning and speaker stance | 0421–0610; 1111–1270: explicit wording plus recoverable context, speakers' own judgments, reservations and reactions. | An interpretation stays attributed where intent is not established. |
| Precise qualification | 0241–0610; 0791–0960: stated conditions, uncertainty, degree, comparison baseline and bounded commitments. | Partial evidence remains partial; proposal, agreement and execution stay distinct. |
| Register control | 0611–0790; 1111–1400: audience-sensitive professional explanation, familiar interaction and expressly marked written genres. | No expression is universally more polite merely because it is longer. |
| Advanced collocations | 0001–0240; 0791–1270: useful lexical and governed units with stated arguments, actors and constraints. | The whole hidden unit, its actual contextual meaning and grammatical label must agree. |
| Professional terminology | 0611–0790: work, education, services, nonclinical care and community tasks with recoverable responsibilities. | Fictional local arrangements do not establish technical, medical or legal rules. |
| Long-form argument | 0791–0960, building on 0241–0420: assumptions, reasons, objections, concessions, comparisons and consequences in self-contained original cases. | Cards teach components, not a complete long-argument performance. |
| Natural reformulation | 0361–0420; 0791–1110; attributed H responses: preserve source agency, quantity, qualification and commitment. | Reformulation does not quietly change a proposal into a promise or an unresolved objection into agreement. |
| Fast unscripted listening | 0961–1110; 1271–1370: intelligible written exchanges, continuation, hesitation, repair, boundary and register cues. | No audio, fast listening, imagined prosody or live listening performance was tested. |
| Interruption and turn management | 0961–1110: interrupted point, floor claimant, continuation, clarification or changed stance supplied in the exchange. | Written interaction components do not establish live group interaction. |
| Regional vocabulary recognition | 1271–1330: explicitly attributed Spain, Colombia and River Plate meanings; 1331–1370 supplies context-justified Mexican familiar uses. | Region attribution does not prove exclusivity, frequency, nationality, class or universal acceptability. |
| Pragmatic softening and indirectness | 1111–1270, supported by 0421–0610: actual beneficiary, request, authority, urgency, freedom to decline and speaker reaction. | Notes cannot supply a missing motive, shared assumption or reaction. |

## New learning and breadth

The actual 1,400 primary objectives extend accepted 01–04 through new lexical forms, distinct contextual senses, governed constructions and interaction/register contrasts. Earlier hidden components remain earlier learning even inside a longer former target. Concrete overlap repairs include PREAVISO (0331) instead of previously hidden ANTELACIÓN, MENSAJERO (0416) instead of already hidden INTERMEDIARIO, CONDICIONAL (0471) instead of an ordinary known-verb participle, VIGILANCIA (0621) instead of already hidden SEGUIMIENTO, and EVALUACIÓN FORMATIVA (0717) instead of bare EVALUACIÓN already hidden inside AUTOEVALUACIÓN/COEVALUACIÓN. The unauthored MUGRE slot was replaced with TIZNE (1365), a verified soot noun, rather than extracting the same dirt base after MUGRERO. New nominalizations and word-family members explicitly acknowledge known related verbs or functions; ordinary new inflections alone do not qualify.

## Verified primary-reference decisions and limits

All cases are original authored situations. The guide supplies requirements, primary references resolve uncertain usage, and authored expansion supplies the particular scenario. Dictionary wording, examples, real research results or exam tasks are not copied. Failed target reads are not verification; a missing entry is not a grammatical ban. Relevant retained decisions accompany the content/review processes as they become available and are included in the complete final pass; this is a concise selection of decisions material to the content, not a claim that dictionaries certify every sentence.

- [DLE obviar](https://dle.rae.es/obviar) supports the selected setting-aside sense; other senses are not categorically prohibited. Ordinary physical, culinary and interpersonal senses are distinguished from figurative or institutional ones in the actual mappings.
- [DLE quicio](https://dle.rae.es/quicio) and [quicial](https://dle.rae.es/quicial) resolve the actual physical mechanism: the selected fixed support receives the door's pivot pin. An arbitrary frame location or any hinge is not treated as the same object, and no universal door construction is claimed.
- [DLE competencia](https://dle.rae.es/competencia), [devengar](https://dle.rae.es/devengar), [homologar](https://dle.rae.es/homologar) and [optimizar](https://dle.rae.es/optimizar) support the selected entrusted-responsibility, earning-entitlement, equating and method-improvement cases; those cases do not establish further authority, receipt of money, official certification or proof of a global optimum.
- [SEP/DGESuM assessment PDF](https://dgesum.sep.gob.mx/storage/recursos/ediciones/normalismo/libros/i17dYhxrJX-76.pdf), printed pp. 81 and 83, supports RÚBRICA with named criteria and concrete achievement levels. [UNAM CUAED 2020](https://cuaed.unam.mx/descargas/Evaluacion-para-la-Educacion-a-distancia-estrategias-en-situacion-de-emergencia.pdf), printed pp. 13, 16–17, supports ongoing formative feedback, self-assessment and the selected peer coassessment case; coassessment is not universally limited to peers. [UNAM CUAIEED 2023](https://cuaed.unam.mx/descargas/CajaHerramientas6.pdf), printed p. 9, supports temporary adjustable ANDAMIAJE that is withdrawn; no historical-origin or guaranteed-learning claim is used.
- [UNAM DGOAE](https://dgoae.unam.mx/AVirtual/) supports listening/supportive CONTENCIÓN as distinct from specialist referral. The ordinary self-reported case is neither restraint nor a clinical method or guaranteed outcome. The failed DEM target read was not used as verification.
- [DLE autodeterminación](https://dle.rae.es/autodeterminaci%C3%B3n), [colegiado](https://dle.rae.es/colegiado), [abstraer](https://dle.rae.es/abstraer) and [presunción](https://dle.rae.es/presunci%C3%B3n) support the selected personal choice, joint action, intellectual abstraction and ordinary provisional-belief senses; no political rule, unanimity requirement or legal presumption is introduced.
- [RAE student amparo](https://www.rae.es/diccionario-estudiante/amparo) and [Fundéu amparo](https://www.fundeu.es/consulta/bajo-el-amparo-de-al-amparo-de-3294/) support AL AMPARO DE as protection. [DLE pugna](https://dle.rae.es/pugna) supports opposition, distinct from earlier PUGNAR POR striving. [DLE explayar](https://dle.rae.es/explayar) supports pronominal elaboration; earlier DAR A ENTENDER remains known learning.
- [DLE dejar](https://dle.rae.es/dejar), DEJAR CAER, supports the selected initially concealed hinting intention, later explicitly confirmed by the speaker. This does not turn an omitted particular complement into a grammatical ban.
- [DLE acaso](https://dle.rae.es/acaso) distinguishes restrictive SI ACASO from precautionary POR SI ACASO. [DLE cuchara](https://dle.rae.es/cuchara) supports possessive METER SU CUCHARA for inopportune intrusion; failure to verify another variant does not prohibit it.
- [DLE trastabillar](https://dle.rae.es/trastabillar), sense 3, supports the selected reported speaking difficulty; the case establishes faltering in speech rather than relying only on reversed factual order. No medical diagnosis or measured delivery is asserted.
- [DLE vocalizar](https://dle.rae.es/vocalizar) labels the selected articulation sense intransitive; the actual request uses an intransitive frame with the repeated word identified separately. This does not claim a universal ban on transitive usage. [DPD raya](https://www.rae.es/dpd/raya), §2.3a–c, distinguishes terminal narrator comments from those interrupting speech that immediately resumes; ordinary parenthetical incisos have their separate rule.
- [DLE coletilla](https://dle.rae.es/coletilla) and [muletilla](https://dle.rae.es/muletilla) permit overlap rather than a false mandatory final/internal division. [DLE ustedear](https://dle.rae.es/ustedear) supports addressing as USTED without a universal age/status requirement.
- [DLE conminar](https://dle.rae.es/conminar), [condonar](https://dle.rae.es/condonar) and [dignarse](https://dle.rae.es/dignarse) support the bounded selected threat, private-debt remission and expressly attributed reproach cases; no inherent negative-frequency rule or unmentioned authority is asserted.
- [DLE complacencia](https://dle.rae.es/complacencia), [galantería](https://dle.rae.es/galanter%C3%ADa), [venia](https://dle.rae.es/venia), [licencia](https://dle.rae.es/licencia) and [familiar](https://dle.rae.es/familiar) distinguish satisfaction, courtesy, permission and informal interpersonal/register senses without automatic ingratiation, romance, public authorization or wealth judgments.
- [DLE paño](https://dle.rae.es/pa%C3%B1o) supports the figurative PAÑOS CALIENTES senses; the separate Mexican PAÑOS TIBIOS listing does not ban CALIENTES. [DLE discreción](https://dle.rae.es/discreci%C3%B3n) distinguishes judgment from privacy and unlimited whim; [voluntad](https://dle.rae.es/voluntad) supports choice within the actual stated permission.
- Selected Spain and Colombia recognition uses the actually checked [DLE](https://dle.rae.es/) and [ASALE Diccionario de americanismos](https://www.asale.org/damer/) senses, with regional source and exact sense in each mapping. PERICO is the selected small coffee-with-milk usage in central Colombia/Bogotá; PARCHE is the meeting-place sense; CUCHO is a self-attributed older-age adjective; ROLO/CACHACO use their selected adjectival senses; FRESCO is reassuring interjection. Shared CANSÓN is not declared exclusive to Colombia.
- River Plate recognition separates tender CHAUCHAS pods from POROTOS seeds, Argentine FACTURA pastry from an invoice, plural CHAMPIONES sports shoes, and selected REGIO adverb/BÁRBARO interjection from unrelated senses. The DA usage label on CHAMPIÓN is not turned into a frequency claim. Currency examples are original local arithmetic, not current prices or exchange rates.
- [DLE tizne](https://dle.rae.es/tizne) supports smoke deposit on cooking vessels, with masculine or feminine gender; the selected masculine case identifies an already cold pan and bounded cleaning permission, rather than general MUGRERO dirt or a charred stick. The DEM target read failed and was not used as verification. [DPD sartén](https://www.rae.es/dpd/sart%C3%A9n) records both genders in the Americas; the selected masculine pan frame is retained without a country-specific frequency claim.
- [Diccionario del español de México](https://dem.colmex.mx/) and actually checked DA entries support the selected Mexican familiar senses: CÁMARA surprise, ABUSADO alert interjection, MUGRERO accumulated dirt, FRESA self-attributed conventional preference, MERO exact location and NOMÁS only. No unsupported acceptance sense, grammatical imperative or social-class proof is credited. Written recognition distinguishes ACÁPITE paragraph, EPÍGRAFE heading, bibliographic COLOFÓN, nominalized signing participle SUSCRITO, immediately following SUBSIGUIENTE and distributive SENDOS; productive SUBAPARTADO formation is supported by the retained checked Fundéu prefix guidance, not a guessed missing headword definition.

## Cross-cutting editorial scope and process

Every utterance carries essential participants, ownership, beneficiary, time, quantity, comparison and evidential limits. Notes supply useful vocabulary or exact-form support. Whole-span glosses and labels match compact hidden targets; one raw occurrence, ordinary NFC spelling, punctuation, meaningful boundaries and exact answer are required. Productive address is contemporary central Mexican TÚ/USTED/USTEDES; marked regional address and vocabulary stay attributed. Generic masculine forms do not by themselves establish male identity, occupation, family relation, wealth or intent. Accepted answers remain explicit rather than automatically expanded. Logical audio paths are validated without MP3 files.

Ordinary review used 35 consecutive batches of 40: one fresh author and separate fresh editor per batch. EXECUTOR read every complete output and adjudicated findings before saving. All required processes use the unchanged authorized Codex CLI 0.163.0 `gpt-6.1-sol`, high reasoning, ephemeral read-only execution and structured JSON, sequentially without reuse, nested agents, child repository edits or fallback. The actual verified per-call plugin, Firecrawl MCP-server and plugins-feature disabling precedes the first and every subsequent launch. During Spanish 05, no Firecrawl startup/use or permission request occurred. Temporary prompts, outputs and evidence remain in local `/tmp/meiki-decks-es-05/`.

The single complete final pass covered these consecutive exhaustive partitions: 0001–0100 (100); 0101–0200 (100); 0201–0300 (100); 0301–0400 (100); 0401–0500 (100); 0501–0550 (50); 0551–0600 (50); 0601–0700 (100); 0701–0750 (50); 0751–0800 (50); 0801–0850 (50); 0851–0900 (50); 0901–0950 (50); 0951–1000 (50); 1001–1050 (50); 1051–1100 (50); 1101–1150 (50); 1151–1200 (50); 1201–1250 (50); 1251–1275 (25); 1276–1300 (25); 1301–1350 (50); 1351–1400 (50). Smaller partitions were used only where measured complete prompts exceeded the known 1,048,576-character limit. Every field/mapping and all directly cited complete earlier prerequisites were retained, with a nonredundant complete preceding hidden inventory. EXECUTOR read all final outputs, applied verified findings together and inspected affected dependencies. Final consolidated count/source/coverage/preservation checks and exact-head normal CI are reported in the PR.

One prelaunch wrapper exception was retained honestly: a temporary expected-ID prefix error stopped ingestion before source writes, so the following dependent prompt was absent and shell redirection failed before Codex executed. That failed wrapper started zero model processes/threads/content turns; its underlying CLI status is inapplicable, not lost. The helper and preflight were corrected before the ordinary sequence continued, with no extra model round. Actual content CLI statuses, distinct fresh threads, completed turns and final findings are reported in the PR independently of this non-content wrapper failure.

This text stage does not claim native-human review, actual listening, live interaction, runtime/import/export verification, independently recomputed predecessor checksums, official examination inventory, vocabulary knowledge or proficiency. Repository checks validate source structure and traceability, not linguistic certification. No installations, audio, application work or later stage is included.
